project_metadata.description: Glassmorphic landing page for BD Caller ISP VoIP & recharge platform—branding, features, animated mockup, pricing, testimonials, in one smoothly-animated, beautiful Arc Browser-inspired page.
project_metadata.core_purpose: Showcase BD Caller's VoIP calling and mobile recharge for Bangladesh, drive downloads and free sign-ups.
project_metadata.target_audience: Bangladesh mobile users seeking VoIP/recharge; tech-savvy, ages 18-40
key_features: Operator cards: GP, Robi, Banglalink, Teletalk, Airtel
Sticky glass nav, footer, fully mobile responsive

pages.purpose: Public landing/marketing page for BD Caller. Showcase features, drive app downloads/signup, inform about pricing and operator coverage.
pages.description: Single glass/soft-futuristic landing page: stacked sections—Hero (brand, tagline, CTAs, mockup), Features (interactive cards), How-It-Works (visual 3-step), Operators grid, Pricing/Call rates (interactive cards), 3-person testimonials, Download app CTA, and Footer. All sections flow vertically, max-w 1440px, responsive to 375px, consistent glassmorphic style, generous border radii, soft purple accent. Layout: header/fixed nav on glass, sections with overlapping gradients, no modal needed, all actions scroll-in-page only.
pages.content_notes: All content uses glassmorphic/soft-futurism aesthetic, pastel purple gradients, radius 24-32px, perfect pixel grid. No page transitions—use smooth scroll. Button click effects are animated. Features grid and testimonials adapt mobile. Framer Motion handles animations on entry/hover. Placeholder for mobile app store buttons.

theme.design_dna: Arc Browser glass/soft-futurism: semi-transparent frosted glass surfaces, backdrop blur (blur-lg), pastel background radial gradients (light lilac, blue, purple, mint), soft purple accent (#8b5cf6), generous border radius (24-32px), inner and drop shadows, smooth Framer Motion anims for all interactive and entry states, border color transitions, light airy typography (Inter/SF Pro/rounded sans-serif), soft focus imagery, abundant vertical and horizontal padding, CTA buttons pill-shaped with glass/blend backgrounds.
theme.shadow_style: Glassmorphic: inner soft shadow, subtle drop shadow on overlays
theme.animation_style: Framer Motion fade, scale, glass-glow on hover/tap; subtle floating/mockups bounce.
theme.interaction_style: Button/click: Framer Motion ripple, card lift+shadow glow on hover, scroll-linked section highlight, horizontal swipes (testimonials mobile), all CTAs animated.

components.description: Full-width glassmorphic navigation bar, flexbox horizontal layout, 24px vertical padding, backdrop-blur-lg, semi-transparent frosted glass background, sticky top z-50. Logo left (BD Caller textmark/logo in bold, 2xl font, soft-purple accent), navigation links right (anchor, medium weight, 1.1rem). CTAs (Download, Get Started Free) as pill-shaped buttons with inner-shadow, radial pastel highlights, strong hover glow. On mobile: collapses into a minimal fixed top bar with burger menu for feature-scroll links.

Flexbox center-aligned, vertical on mobile, generous 64px horizontal/32px vertical padding, 2 layers of glass panels with pastel radial gradients (#ede9fe→#f3f4f6). Left column: Logo above, tagline center (xl, semibold), supporting blurb below (md, light), 2 CTA buttons (Download App, Get Started Free; pill-shaped, animated ripple-feedback, soft shadow). Right: Animated phone mockup (SVG/PNG) with simulated calling UI, floating above blurred glass panel, subtle Framer Motion bounce and ambient particle motion. z-20 for image overlay. Responsive: stacks vertically with buttons full width on small.
components.purpose: First impression with brand core offers, instant access CTAs

components.description: Responsive CSS grid (2 columns desktop, 1 column mobile), 6 feature cards spaced by 40px gap, frosted glass background on cards, 24px rounded corners, 16px padding per card. Each card: large soft-cast icon in soft purple, title (lg, semibold), short description (sm, light). Card hover: lift-up, strong glow border, subtle scaling via Framer Motion. Cards: VoIP Calling, Mobile Recharge, Wallet Balance, Call History, Secure Payments, Admin Dashboard.
components.purpose: Displays core feature highlights as interactive cards

components.description: Horizontal flex layout (vertical stack mobile), center-aligned, 3 glassmorphic step cards (32px round corners, shadow), numbered avatars (gradient pill+number), icon and step title (lg, semibold), description (sm). Steps are connected by softly glowing animated lines/arrows that pulse in sequence (Framer Motion). Steps: 1 Register, 2 Top Up Wallet, 3 Call & Recharge. Responsive: stacks 1-2-3 vertically with connector lines reflowed.

CSS flexbox grid, equal-width operator cards with logo centered (high-res PNG/SVG logo, on frosted glass, blur), pastel border ring, operator name below (md, medium). 16px spacing, glass effect with soft shadow on hover, card scale-up and pastel highlight ring on hover (Framer Motion). 5 operators: Grameenphone, Robi, Banglalink, Teletalk, Airtel. Responsive to 2x3 grid on small viewports.

Horizontal 3-card flex layout (vertical stack mobile), each glass card (ISP VoIP, Standard, Premium) gets pastel gradient border, plan title (lg, semibold, purple), call rate large (2xl, bold), smaller note below. Hover: glass deepen, border animate pulse using Framer Motion. Cards separated by 24px gap. All spacing/radius generous (24px).
components.purpose: Highlights sample call rate plans interactively

components.description: Horizontal scrollable row (swipe/drag mobile), 3 frosted cards with avatar (circle, drop-shadow), name (md, medium), review (normal, light), gentle pastel border. Cards lift subtly on hover, review text animates glow briefly on load. Responsive: stack into column, avatars shrink. Framer Motion for fade+shift-in.
components.purpose: Shows 3 user testimonials for trust/social proof

components.description: Full-width, glass-blur surface, soft radial gradient overlay, large title (lg, bold, purple-accent), 2 app store buttons (App Store, Google Play; pill, outline, animated on tap), stacked vertically on mobile. CTA buttons: logo+text, generous radius, animate pop-in on view. Below: tiny support info (sm).
components.purpose: Final encouragement to download/open app, funnelling users to app stores

components.description: Glass-blur footer, inset shadow, horizontal just-between layout, 24px top/bottom spacing, color #8b5cf6 for key links. Left: small logo, center: navigation footer links (light hover, underline on hover), right: contact info (icon+text, email/phone). Bottom: x-small, copyright line. Mobile: vertical stack, links center-aligned.
components.purpose: Page closure, useful links, legal/contact info

frontend.styling: Tailwind v4 with custom colors/gradients, utility classes, backdrop blur, generative pastel backgrounds
frontend.animation: Framer Motion for section and element entrance, hover, CTA ripple/scale.
